name: version-list
title: Version List
description: A document's version history — time, author, name, kind badges (Current, Restored, Unsaved copy), a Named only switch and Load more — as a keyboard listbox.

meta.whenToUse: A page's version history beside a DiffView, in a sheet.
meta.whenNotToUse: An activity feed (Timeline) or a list of records (DataList).
